title: Implement a deterministic token-bucket rate limiter
prompt: You are working in the current directory. There is a file `rate_limiter.py` containing a class `TokenBucket` whose `__init__` and `allow` methods raise `NotImplementedError`. Implement both methods exactly according to the docstrings already written in the file. The class must never read a real clock (no `time.time()` or similar); the current time is always supplied by the caller as the `now` argument to `allow`. Do not change the class name, method names, or signatures.
